pipelines.name: Benchmark

steps.name: Resolve run plan
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if [[ -n "$COMMIT" && ! "$COMMIT" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
  echo '::error::Commit must be a full 40-character lowercase SHA'
  exit 1
fi

if [[ -n "$COMMIT" ]]; then
  trigger=backfill
  sha="$COMMIT"
elif [[ "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" == "schedule" ]]; then
  trigger=nightly
  sha="$GITHUB_SHA"
else
  trigger=manual
  sha="$GITHUB_SHA"
fi

case "$DESTINATION" in
  # BigQuery stays out until its benchmark secret and project/dataset variables exist.
  all) destinations='["null","clickhouse","snowflake"]' ;;
  null | clickhouse | bigquery | snowflake) destinations="[\"$DESTINATION\"]" ;;
  *)
    echo "::error::Unknown destination: $DESTINATION"
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

{
  echo "sha=$sha"
  echo "trigger=$trigger"
  echo "destinations=$destinations"
  echo "runner=$RUNNER"
} >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Install system tools
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
missing_packages=()
if ! command -v go >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  missing_packages+=(golang-go)
fi
if ! command -v psql >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  missing_packages+=(postgresql-client)
fi
if ! command -v unzip >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  missing_packages+=(unzip)
fi
if (( ${#missing_packages[@]} > 0 )); then
  sudo apt-get update
  sudo apt-get install -y "${missing_packages[@]}"
fi
go install github.com/pingcap/go-tpc/cmd/go-tpc@v1.0.12
echo "$(go env GOPATH)/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

steps.name: Start Postgres
steps.run:
POSTGRES_IMAGE=postgres:18 \
POSTGRES_VERSION=18 \
  cargo --locked xtask postgres start --shards 1 --base-port "$POSTGRES_PORT" --source-only

steps.name: Prepare BigQuery key
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if [[ -z "${BQ_SA_KEY_JSON}" ]]; then
  echo "BENCHMARK_BQ_SA_KEY_JSON secret is required for BigQuery benchmarks." >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [[ -z "${BQ_PROJECT_ID}" || -z "${BQ_DATASET_ID}" ]]; then
  echo "BigQuery benchmarks need bq_project_id and bq_dataset_id inputs or the BENCHMARK_BQ_PROJECT_ID and BENCHMARK_BQ_DATASET_ID repository variables." >&2
  exit 1
fi
umask 077
printf '%s' "${BQ_SA_KEY_JSON}" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/bigquery-key.json"

steps.name: Start ClickHouse
steps.run: docker compose -f scripts/docker/docker-compose.yaml up -d --wait clickhouse

steps.name: Check Snowflake connection
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if [[ -z "${BENCH_SNOWFLAKE_CONNECTION}" ]]; then
  echo "BENCH_SNOWFLAKE_CONNECTION secret is required for Snowflake benchmarks." >&2
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Record benchmark environment
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p target/bench-results

tpcc_threads="${TPCC_THREADS_INPUT:-derived}"
host_memory="$(awk '/MemTotal/ { printf "%.2f GiB", $2 / 1024 / 1024 }' /proc/meminfo || true)"
if [[ -z "${host_memory}" ]]; then
  host_memory="unavailable"
fi

cgroup_memory_limit="unavailable"
if [[ -r /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max ]]; then
  cgroup_memory_limit="$(cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max)"
elif [[ -r /sys/fs/cgroup/memory/memory.limit_in_bytes ]]; then
  cgroup_memory_limit="$(cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory/memory.limit_in_bytes)"
fi

{
  echo "## 🖥️ Benchmark environment"
  echo
  echo "| Setting | Value |"
  echo "| --- | --- |"
  echo "| Commit | $(git rev-parse HEAD) |"
  echo "| Trigger | ${BENCHMARK_TRIGGER} |"
  echo "| Runner | ${BENCHMARK_RUNNER} |"
  echo "| Runner name | ${RUNNER_NAME} |"
  echo "| Runner OS | ${RUNNER_OS} |"
  echo "| Runner arch | ${RUNNER_ARCH} |"
  echo "| CPUs | $(nproc) |"
  echo "| Host memory | ${host_memory} |"
  echo "| Cgroup memory limit | ${cgroup_memory_limit} |"
  echo "| Warehouses | ${WAREHOUSES} |"
  echo "| TPC-C threads | ${tpcc_threads} |"
  echo "| Measured samples | ${BENCHMARK_SAMPLES} |"
  echo "| Warmup samples | ${BENCHMARK_WARMUP_SAMPLES} |"
  echo "| Memory budget ratio | ${MEMORY_BUDGET_RATIO} |"
  echo "| Memory backpressure | ${ENABLE_MEMORY_BACKPRESSURE} |"
  echo "| Destination | ${DESTINATION} |"
} >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

steps.name: Run benchmarks
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

args=(
  benchmark
  --host "$POSTGRES_HOST"
  --port "$POSTGRES_PORT"
  --database "$POSTGRES_DB"
  --username "$POSTGRES_USER"
  --password "$POSTGRES_PASSWORD"
  --warehouses "$WAREHOUSES"
  --streaming-drain-quiet-ms "$STREAMING_DRAIN_QUIET_MS"
  --max-table-sync-workers "$MAX_TABLE_SYNC_WORKERS"
  --max-copy-connections-per-table "$MAX_COPY_CONNECTIONS_PER_TABLE"
  --batch-max-fill-ms "$BATCH_MAX_FILL_MS"
  --memory-budget-ratio "$MEMORY_BUDGET_RATIO"
  --destination "$DESTINATION"
  --samples "$BENCHMARK_SAMPLES"
  --warmup-samples "$BENCHMARK_WARMUP_SAMPLES"
  --output-dir target/bench-results
)

if [[ -n "$TPCC_THREADS_INPUT" ]]; then
  args+=(--tpcc-threads "$TPCC_THREADS_INPUT")
fi

if [[ -n "$STREAMING_DURATION_SECONDS" ]]; then
  args+=(--streaming-duration-seconds "$STREAMING_DURATION_SECONDS")
fi

if [[ "$ENABLE_MEMORY_BACKPRESSURE" == "true" ]]; then
  args+=(--enable-memory-backpressure)
fi

if [[ "$FORCE_PREPARE" == "true" ]]; then
  args+=(--force-prepare)
fi

if [[ "$SKIP_TABLE_COPY" == "true" ]]; then
  args+=(--skip-table-copy)
fi

if [[ "$SKIP_TABLE_STREAMING" == "true" ]]; then
  args+=(--skip-table-streaming)
fi

if [[ "$DESTINATION" == "bigquery" ]]; then
  args+=(--bq-project-id "$BQ_PROJECT_ID")
  args+=(--bq-dataset-id "$BQ_DATASET_ID")
  args+=(--bq-sa-key-file "$BQ_SA_KEY_FILE")
fi

cargo --locked xtask "${args[@]}"

steps.name: Write run manifest
Summarize benchmark results
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

python3 <<'PY' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
import json
from pathlib import Path

results_dir = Path("target/bench-results")

def load(name):
    path = results_dir / name
    if not path.exists():
        return None
    return json.loads(path.read_text())

def number(value, digits=2):
    if value is None:
        return "-"
    if isinstance(value, int) or float(value).is_integer():
        return f"{int(value):,}"
    return f"{float(value):,.{digits}f}"

def seconds(ms):
    if ms is None:
        return "-"
    return f"{float(ms) / 1000:,.2f} s"

def pct(value):
    if value is None:
        return "-"
    return f"{float(value):,.2f}%"

def samples(report):
    sample_count = report.get("sample_count")
    warmup_count = report.get("warmup_sample_count", 0)
    if sample_count is None:
        return "1"
    if warmup_count:
        return f"{sample_count} + {warmup_count} warmup"
    return str(sample_count)

def spread(report, key):
    return pct((report.get("sample_summary") or {}).get(key, {}).get("spread_pct"))

def table(headers, rows):
    print("| " + " | ".join(headers) + " |")
    print("| " + " | ".join("---" for _ in headers) + " |")
    for row in rows:
        print("| " + " | ".join(str(cell) for cell in row) + " |")

table_copy = load("table_copy.json")
table_streaming = load("table_streaming.json")

print()
print("## 📊 Benchmark results")
print()

summary = []
if table_copy:
    summary.append([
        "📦 Table copy",
        f"{number(table_copy.get('rows_per_second'))} rows/s",
        f"{number(table_copy.get('estimated_mib_per_second'))} MiB/s",
        seconds(table_copy.get("total_ms")),
        spread(table_copy, "rows_per_second"),
    ])
if table_streaming:
    summary.append([
        "🔁 Table streaming",
        f"{number(table_streaming.get('end_to_end_with_shutdown_events_per_second'))} events/s",
        f"{number(table_streaming.get('end_to_end_with_shutdown_estimated_mib_per_second'))} MiB/s",
        seconds(table_streaming.get("total_ms")),
        spread(table_streaming, "end_to_end_with_shutdown_events_per_second"),
    ])

if summary:
    table(["Benchmark", "Median throughput", "Data rate", "Total", "Sample spread"], summary)
    print()
else:
    print("No benchmark JSON reports were written.")
    raise SystemExit(0)

if table_copy:
    print("### 📦 Table copy")
    table(
        ["Metric", "Value"],
        [
            ["Samples", samples(table_copy)],
            ["Rows copied", number(table_copy.get("copied_rows"))],
            ["Rows/s", number(table_copy.get("rows_per_second"))],
            ["Rows/s spread", spread(table_copy, "rows_per_second")],
            ["Decoded MiB", number(table_copy.get("estimated_copied_mib"))],
            ["Decoded MiB/s", number(table_copy.get("estimated_mib_per_second"))],
            ["Decoded MiB/s spread", spread(table_copy, "estimated_mib_per_second")],
            ["Copy wait", seconds(table_copy.get("copy_wait_ms"))],
            ["Total", seconds(table_copy.get("total_ms"))],
        ],
    )
    print()

if table_streaming:
    print("### 🔁 Table streaming")
    stats = table_streaming.get("destination_stats", {})
    table(
        ["Metric", "Value"],
        [
            ["Samples", samples(table_streaming)],
            ["Workload", table_streaming.get("workload", "-")],
            ["Produced events", number(table_streaming.get("produced_events"))],
            ["Observed CDC events", number(table_streaming.get("observed_cdc_events"))],
            ["Events/s", number(table_streaming.get("end_to_end_with_shutdown_events_per_second"))],
            ["Events/s spread", spread(table_streaming, "end_to_end_with_shutdown_events_per_second")],
            ["Decoded MiB/s", number(table_streaming.get("end_to_end_with_shutdown_estimated_mib_per_second"))],
            ["Decoded MiB/s spread", spread(table_streaming, "end_to_end_with_shutdown_estimated_mib_per_second")],
            ["Inserts", number(stats.get("inserts"))],
            ["Updates", number(stats.get("updates"))],
            ["Deletes", number(stats.get("deletes"))],
            ["Total", seconds(table_streaming.get("total_ms"))],
        ],
    )
    print()
PY

pipelines.name: CI metrics

steps.name: Build collector
steps.run: cargo --locked build --quiet --target-dir target/xtask --package xtask

steps.name: Sync
steps.run:
if ! [[ "$MAX_REQUESTS" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || (( MAX_REQUESTS > 700 )); then
  echo "::error::max_requests must be a number up to 700"
  exit 1
fi
# GitHub masks only the whole secret. Mask the parts a database
# error could echo too, in case one ever escapes the collector's
# redaction: the user, its project ref, and the host.
rest="${CI_METRICS_DATABASE_URL#*://}"
user="${rest%%:*}"
host="${rest#*@}"
host="${host%%[:/?]*}"
for value in "$user" "${user#*.}" "$host"; do
  if [[ -n "$value" ]]; then echo "::add-mask::$value"; fi
done
target/xtask/debug/xtask ci-metrics sync --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --max-requests "$MAX_REQUESTS"

steps.name: Check MSRV consistency
steps.run:
python3 - <<'PYTHON'
import re
import tomllib
from pathlib import Path

with open("Cargo.toml", "rb") as source:
    workspace = tomllib.load(source)["workspace"]
with open("rust-toolchain.toml", "rb") as source:
    toolchain = tomllib.load(source)["toolchain"]["channel"]
if workspace["package"]["rust-version"] != toolchain:
    raise SystemExit("Workspace MSRV must match rust-toolchain.toml")
dockerfile = Path("crates/etl-replicator/Dockerfile").read_text()
if not re.search(rf"^ARG RUST_VERSION={re.escape(toolchain)}$", dockerfile, re.M):
    raise SystemExit("Docker Rust version must match rust-toolchain.toml")
network_dockerfile = Path("scripts/network-tests/Dockerfile").read_text()
if not re.search(rf"^FROM rust:{re.escape(toolchain)}-", network_dockerfile, re.M):
    raise SystemExit("Network fixture Rust image must match rust-toolchain.toml")
if not re.search(rf"^ENV RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN={re.escape(toolchain)}(?:\s|$)", network_dockerfile, re.M):
    raise SystemExit("Network fixture Rust override must match rust-toolchain.toml")

for member in workspace["members"]:
    with (Path(member) / "Cargo.toml").open("rb") as source:
        declared = tomllib.load(source)["package"].get("rust-version")
    if declared is not None and declared not in ({"workspace": True}, toolchain):
        raise SystemExit(f"MSRV mismatch in {member}")
PYTHON

pipelines.name: Prepare release

steps.name: Set workspace version
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if [[ -n "${MANUAL_RELEASE}" ]]; then
  if [[ ! "${MANUAL_RELEASE}" =~ ^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$ ]]; then
    echo "Provided release '${MANUAL_RELEASE}' is not a valid SemVer (expected X.Y.Z)." >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  echo "Setting workspace version to ${MANUAL_RELEASE} (manual)."
  cargo set-version --workspace "${MANUAL_RELEASE}"
else
  echo "Bumping workspace version by '${BUMP}'."
  cargo set-version --workspace --bump "${BUMP}"
fi

steps.name: Read release version
steps.run:
python3 - <<'PYTHON'
import os
import re
import tomllib

with open("crates/etl-replicator/Cargo.toml", "rb") as manifest:
    version = tomllib.load(manifest)["package"]["version"]
if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+", version):
    raise SystemExit("Expected package version X.Y.Z")
with open(os.environ["GITHUB_OUTPUT"], "a") as output:
    output.write(f"next={version}\n")

steps.name: Validate release version
steps.run:
python3 - <<'PYTHON'
import os
import re
import tomllib

with open("crates/etl-replicator/Cargo.toml", "rb") as manifest:
    package_version = tomllib.load(manifest)["package"]["version"]
branch = os.environ.get("PR_HEAD_REF", "")
if not branch.startswith("release/v"):
    raise SystemExit("Expected release branch release/vX.Y.Z")
version = branch.removeprefix("release/v")
if not re.fullmatch(r"(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)", version):
    raise SystemExit("Expected release version X.Y.Z without leading zeroes")
if version != package_version:
    raise SystemExit("Release version must match the checked-out package version")
with open(os.environ["GITHUB_OUTPUT"], "a") as output:
    output.write(f"version={version}\ntag=v{version}\n")

steps.name: Validate build worker size
Validate image tags
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

sha=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
main_sha=$(git rev-parse origin/main)
if [[ "$STABLE" == true ]]; then
  if [[ -n "$COMMIT" ]] || ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "$sha" "$main_sha"; then
    echo '::error::Stable publication must build the merged main commit without a source override'
    exit 1
  fi
  tags="$sha"
  if [[ -n "$VERSION" ]]; then
    if [[ ! "$VERSION" =~ ^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$ ]]; then
      echo '::error::Release version must have the form X.Y.Z without leading zeroes'
      exit 1
    fi
    if [[ "$(git rev-parse "refs/tags/v$VERSION^{commit}")" != "$sha" ]]; then
      echo '::error::Release tag must point to the merged commit'
      exit 1
    fi
    tags="$sha v$VERSION"
  fi
else
  if [[ -n "$VERSION" ]]; then
    echo '::error::Release image tags require a push to main'
    exit 1
  fi
  tags="$sha-experimental"
fi
{
  echo "sha=$sha"
  echo "tags=$tags"
  echo "stable=$STABLE"
} >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Record platform digest
steps.run:
mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/digests"
printf '%s\n' "$DIGEST" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/digests/$ARCH.txt"

steps.name: Publish and verify multi-platform manifests
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
: "${IMAGE:?Registry image is required}"
: "${TAGS:?Image tags are required}"

digests=()
for arch in amd64 arm64; do
  digest=$(cat "$DIGEST_DIRECTORY/$arch.txt")
  if [[ ! "$digest" =~ ^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$ ]]; then
    echo "::error::Invalid $arch image digest"
    exit 1
  fi
  digests+=("$digest")
done

read -r -a tags <<< "$TAGS"
sources=()
tag_args=()
for digest in "${digests[@]}"; do sources+=("$IMAGE@$digest"); done
for tag in "${tags[@]}"; do tag_args+=(--tag "$IMAGE:$tag"); done
# Inspect the combined index before assigning any deployable tags.
docker buildx imagetools create --dry-run "${sources[@]}" |
  jq -e '[.manifests[].platform | select(.os == "linux") | .architecture] | sort == ["amd64", "arm64"]'
docker buildx imagetools create "${tag_args[@]}" "${sources[@]}"
docker buildx imagetools inspect --raw "$IMAGE:${tags[0]}" |
  jq -e '[.manifests[].platform | select(.os == "linux") | .architecture] | sort == ["amd64", "arm64"]'

steps.name: Promote current main image
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
: "${IMAGE:?Registry image is required}"

main_sha=$(git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main | cut -f1)
if [[ -z "$main_sha" ]]; then
  echo '::error::Could not resolve the current main commit'
  exit 1
fi
if [[ "$SOURCE_SHA" != "$main_sha" ]]; then
  echo 'Skipping latest promotion because main has advanced.'
  exit 0
fi
docker buildx imagetools create --tag "$IMAGE:latest" "$IMAGE:$SOURCE_SHA"

steps.name: Size Postgres shards
steps.run:
max_shards=16
shard_memory_kib=$((3 * 1024 * 1024))
cpus="$(nproc)"
memory_kib="$(awk '/^MemTotal:/ { print $2 }' /proc/meminfo)"
memory_shards=$((memory_kib / shard_memory_kib))
shards=$((cpus < memory_shards ? cpus : memory_shards))
shards=$((shards < max_shards ? shards : max_shards))
shards=$((shards > 0 ? shards : 1))
free -g
echo "runner has ${cpus} vCPUs and $((memory_kib / 1024)) MiB memory; using ${shards} Postgres shards."
echo "NUM_LOCAL_DATABASES=${shards}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
